title: Detailed planet with rings
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Planet body -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='24' fill='#4A7BC8'/>
  <!-- Planet glow/atmosphere -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='24' fill='none' stroke='#7EB3F0' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Band 1 -->
  <path d='M26 42 Q50 36 74 42 Q74 46 74 46 Q50 40 26 46 Z' fill='#3A6BB8'/>
  <!-- Band 2 -->
  <path d='M27 55 Q50 50 73 55 Q73 59 73 59 Q50 54 27 59 Z' fill='#6AA0E0'/>
  <!-- Band 3 -->
  <path d='M28 62 Q50 58 72 62 Q72 65 72 65 Q50 61 28 65 Z' fill='#3A6BB8' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Band 4 highlight -->
  <path d='M30 48 Q50 44 70 48 Q70 51 70 51 Q50 47 30 51 Z' fill='#8EC4F8' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- Spot storm -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='52' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#C86A3A'/>
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='52' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#E08A5A'/>
  <!-- Ring back (behind planet, top half) -->
  <path d='M8 38 Q18 18 50 14 Q82 18 92 38' fill='none' stroke='#D4C27A' stroke-width='4' opacity='0.55'/>
  <path d='M8 38 Q18 22 50 18 Q82 22 92 38' fill='none' stroke='#F0E0A0' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.4'/>
  <!-- Ring front (in front of planet, bottom elliptical arc) -->
  <path d='M8 62 Q18 82 50 86 Q82 82 92 62' fill='none' stroke='#F0D88A' stroke-width='5'/>
  <path d='M8 62 Q18 78 50 81 Q82 78 92 62' fill='none' stroke='#F8E8B8' stroke-width='2'/>
  <path d='M8 62 Q18 86 50 90 Q82 86 92 62' fill='none' stroke='#C8B060' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Ring side accents -->
  <path d='M8 62 Q6 60 8 58' fill='none' stroke='#F0D88A' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M92 62 Q94 60 92 58' fill='none' stroke='#F0D88A' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Surface craters/features -->
  <circle cx='58' cy='44' r='3' fill='#5A90D8' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='58' r='2.5' fill='#5A90D8' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='56' r='2' fill='#8EC4F8' opacity='0.4'/>
  <!-- Small moon -->
  <circle cx='82' cy='30' r='3.5' fill='#C8D8E8'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='30' r='3.5' fill='none' stroke='#E8F0F8' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='83' cy='29' r='1' fill='#A8B8C8' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
